units.source_text: 一瞬间，筋疲力竭的我甚至怀疑柏木是否为了作弄我的结巴才故意让我这样苦修行的。

en.t: For a moment, exhausted as I was, I even suspected that Kashiwagi had deliberately made me undergo this kind of harsh training in order to tease me about my stutter.

units.source_text: 但是，我又逐渐感到这是试图要用把出不来的声音吹出来的肉体上的努力，

en.t: But gradually I also began to feel that this was a physical effort to force out a voice that would not come out,

units.source_text: 来净化平素害怕结巴而又圆滑地说出头一句话来的精神上的努力。

en.t: an effort meant to purify the mental strain by which I usually feared stuttering yet smoothly managed to utter the first words.

units.source_text: 我还感到这出不来的声音，仿佛早已确实存在于这月光下的静寂的世界的某一角落里。

en.t: I also felt that this voice that would not come out seemed already to exist for certain somewhere in a corner of the silent world under the moonlight.

units.source_text: 我做出了种种努力，最后到达那种声音，并发出那种声音就行了。

en.t: All I had to do was make every kind of effort, finally reach that voice, and let it sound.
